# Validation

```{r model_family_header, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
acousticTS:::.model_family_header(
  family = "essms",
  pages = c(
    Overview = "index.html",
    Theory = "essms-theory.html",
    Implementation = "essms-implementation.html",
    Validation = "essms-validation.html"
  )
)
```

ESSMS is checked with radial and hybrid shell references for elastic-shelled spheres, including shell thickness, shell material, interior material, size, orientation, and frequency coverage.

::: {.tip data-title="Residuals near nulls"}
Mean absolute differences describe the typical agreement; maximum differences are retained because deep nulls can expose localized convention or resolution errors.
:::
